plan.title: Scholarship Applications Overview
plan.subtitle: Summary of applicant demographics, scheme distribution, and approval status

panels.title: Approved Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Approved'

panels.title: Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category" AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Schemes by Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme" AS scheme, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The total number of scholarship applications received is {{p1}}. Among these, {{p2}} have been approved, while {{p4}} remain pending for further review. The average academic performance across all applicants is {{p3}}%. Applications are distributed across multiple districts, with the highest volume coming from the top district in the bar chart. The most popular scheme by application count is {{p7.0}}.
